theme: An open day, the girls home in St. Pete.
greeting: The calendar is clear today, Dan, with the girls home in St. Petersburg. The one thing with your name on it is the reply Erika is waiting on at Brunswick.

needsAttention.title: Erika at Brunswick is waiting to hear back
needsAttention.detail: In your recruiting thread she says she's flexible tomorrow and Wednesday and asks what works for a Teams call. The next move is yours.

needsAttention.title: Hold a Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: Your p1 Todoist task, overdue since Sep 14: a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week, before holiday inventory sells out.

needsAttention.title: Rebook the girls' passport appointment
needsAttention.detail: The p1 reschedule for four expired books was meant to follow the Sept 20 return and is still open in Todoist.

flagged.title: New Google sign-in on a Mac
flagged.detail: Google flagged a new Mac OS sign-in to your account this afternoon; worth a glance to confirm it was you.

flagged.title: Care.com applicant came in
flagged.detail: Jessica G. applied to the caregiver job you posted.

flagged.title: ASA wants your mailing address
flagged.detail: American Sailing asked you to confirm where to send your ASA 101 seals.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters (Responsible Investor, NYT Cooking), receipts, shipping notices, and promos.

resolved.title: ASA 101 sailing certification earned
resolved.detail: American Sailing confirmed your ASA 101 Basic Keelboat certification came through.

recipe.title: Roast Venison Fillet
recipe.why: Autumn calls for game and roots — a lean fillet given a hard sear while the first cold nights settle in.

tasks.title: Get 3 term life quotes for Mike
Drive the Pathfinder Portland to St Pete
Call dermatologist to book an appointment

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar before noon, a rare open stretch with the girls in the house.
No meetings to bend the afternoon around, so it is yours to point wherever it counts.
An unhurried evening at home in St. Petersburg, and venison on the board if you feel like cooking.
